notes.title: Development is still active
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, just a short post to let anyone know that is reading this, the game is still under active development. I recently took a couple of months off after having my first child, so apologies that I've been slow responding to discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll post more about the updates I'm working on when I've got more to show, which should hopefully be soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks Jack[/p]

notes.title: Borubots demo out now!
notes.content:
Hey all,

Thanks for checking out Borubots so far, just a quick post to let you know that a [b]playable free demo of Borubots is out now![/b]

I wanted players to have a pretty full experience of the game, so the demo contains a short but full season, made up of 4 Borubot teams who compete to win the league title over 6 league matches.

There's currently 33 bots to catch, buy or upgrade, each with different weapon types, and 4 towns to explore, so get out there and see what you can find!

If you've got any feedback at all feel free to join me on the discussions board. There's still more I'll be adding to the game, and I'll very likely be updating the demo as I go, so if there's any changes you'd like to see feel free to let me know!

Thanks for checking out Borubots and keeping up with the game's development so far, if you're enjoying what you've seen so far I'd love it if you wishlist the game, it really helps!

Thanks,
Jack
